The launcher's update notice has an "Update now" button that installs the new version and restarts, with no security warning on macOS or Windows. "Download it" is still there.

New option "Show FPS counter" in the launcher settings: a small readout in the corner of the screen with the frame rate, the time per frame and which renderer is drawing. Handy when reporting performance. It is off by default.
The first-launch shader preparation is much shorter.
Lens flares, dust clouds and water splashes no longer draw as flat bright squares in the new renderer.
The ring of light around the melee button prompt is back to its original size in the new renderer.
Light fixtures and lamp shades that should be lit no longer draw dark in the new renderer.
The light shaft under hanging lamps no longer shows as a blocky square in the new renderer.
The new renderer now draws the beam part of gun muzzle flashes.
Machines with fewer than six CPU threads no longer fill the log file with a repeated scheduling warning.
